_comment: External-star `then` forwarding for the #10263 namespace extraction: the external supplies a callable `then` only known at runtime. The runtime `__reExport` merge places it on the extracted simulated namespace, and because the chunk-level `export *` flatten is suppressed for extracted entries, the chunk namespace itself stays non-thenable — so `import('./app.js')` assimilates exactly when the extraction callback returns the merged namespace, matching the unbundled module (and Rollup).
